classic.tar.about: docker save on Docker 29.7.2's classic overlay2 store of a one-file scratch image built there

containerd-resaved.tar.about: classic.tar loaded into a fresh Docker 29.7.2, whose store is containerd's, and saved again there

containerd-built.tar.about: the same Dockerfile built with buildx on the containerd store, which adds a provenance attestation: an index of the image and its attestation
